verdict.rationale: Luma's core interaction is natural-language prompting: text-to-video, plus a reasoning endpoint that accepts messy or chained prompts natively. Luma Agents are described as running multi-step video and image workflows and as researching, generating and refining across media, which points toward operating the product in plain language. However, the evidence never documents that these agents take natural-language commands to drive product operations beyond generation, and there is no hands-on corroboration of agent control. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command control over product operations (editing, managing, workflow steps) via Luma Agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic NL operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Messy or chained prompts work natively. No middleware or prompt engineering required.
Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows
